title: Sigappu Thali
desc: Sadayan does errands for his fellow villagers and lives off their generosity. Soon, a series of circumstances compels him to help Kalamani, the daughter of the head of the village.

title: Sakthi Leelai
desc: Sage Bhringi worships only Lord Shiva, Brahma and Vishnu. When Goddess Parvati stands in his way, he goes to the extent of giving rise to a demon.

title: Sukran
desc: College classmates Ravi and Sandhya are in love with each other. But Sandhya's cruel stepmother wants to marry her off to her uncle, who is a rowdy person willing to go to any extent to stop them.

title: Vishwa Thulasi
desc: Thulasi returns home to teach dance in her village. She thinks of her love Vishwa, but memories of her cousin's obsession trouble her.

title: Nadigan
desc: Desperate for money, a man poses as an elderly tutor for two young women. Later, he catches feelings for one of them while also wooing their guardian at the same time.
